text: わしの　マゴが　でてきて　おしえて　くれるん　だから　とうぜん　じゃな！

structure.jp: わしの　マゴが　でてきて
おしえて　くれるん　だから

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.explanation: くれる after the て-form says someone does the thing as a favour for you. おしえて くれる = 'kindly teaches you'.

patterns.name: 〜んだから
patterns.explanation: んだから gives a reason the speaker treats as obvious, like 'since, after all'. おしえて くれるん だから = 'since he teaches you, after all'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is the old-man way of saying だ, 'it is', and な adds a 'right?' feeling. とうぜん じゃな = 'it's only natural, eh'.
